description: This file implements the 'config' class, which manages hierarchical configuration data including adding, removing, merging, diffing, and applying configuration nodes and attributes. It is part of the Wesnoth project and includes methods for manipulating nested configuration structures.

classes.name: config
classes.description: A class representing hierarchical configuration data with methods for manipulation, comparison, and diffing.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends data from another config object into this one.

methods.name: merge_children
methods.description: Merges multiple child configs under a given key into a single config.

methods.name: child_range
methods.description: Returns a range of child configs for a given key.

methods.name: get_children
methods.description: Retrieves the list of child configs for a given key.

methods.name: add_child
methods.description: Adds a new child config under a specified key.

methods.name: add_child_at
methods.description: Inserts a child config at a specific index under a key.

methods.name: remove_child
methods.description: Removes a child config at a specified index under a key.

methods.name: get_diff
methods.description: Computes the difference between this config and another.

methods.name: apply_diff
methods.description: Applies a diff config to this config.

methods.name: reset_translation
methods.description: Resets translation for all string values.
